title: background-clip - Backgrounds - Tailwind CSS
content_text:
BACKGROUNDS background-clip Utilities for controlling the bounding box of an element's background. Class Styles bg-clip-border background-clip: border-box; bg-clip-padding background-clip: padding-box; bg-clip-content background-clip: content-box; bg-clip-text background-clip: text; EXAMPLES Basic example Use the bg-clip-border, bg-clip-padding, and bg-clip-content utilities to control the bounding box of an element's background: bg-clip-border bg-clip-padding bg-clip-content
Cropping to text Use the bg-clip-text utility to crop an element's background to match the shape of the text: Hello world
